create_SuperGlueImageProcessor: create a SuperGlueImageProcessor instance for keypoint matching image preprocessing
run_SuperGlueImageProcessor_preprocess: run SuperGlueImageProcessor preprocess to convert image pairs into stacked pixel value tensors
